value: Scripts define functions named with underscores (`sb_mksep`, `sb_gc`) but the README documents calling them with hyphens (`sb-mksep`, `gc`, `mksep`). The repo intentionally ships no aliases — commit 845b82b ("Removes inline aliases in favor of user defined aliases in configuration files") moved that responsibility to the user's rc file. When adding a new script, do not put `alias X=Y` lines inside it; just define the function and document the expected alias in README.
